content: There has been a significant increase in the number of pupils in Oxfordshire who are missing more than half of their school days, with one out of every 38 children now categorized as "severely" absent.
While other schools across the UK have already put similar regulations into place, one school in Essex reversed its decision after the head expressed that he faced abuse from parents.
